{{Top|leg}}
The '''Jedi Action genre''' was a genre of [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]]. They were typically over-the-top and unrealistic, featuring [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fighting dangerous opponents. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jedi Action vids were available for rental from [[Hedrett Holovid]], a holovid shop that was located in [[Hedrett]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nek Lawsirk]] was a fan of the genre and would often discuss its merits with [[Gar Bettle]], the owner of Hedrett Holovid. Bettle disliked Jedi Action vids and tried to get him to watch something different instead.
